answer: Agents bond stake, join a Semaphore membership tree, and evaluate a committed epoch polynomial whose shares enforce each rate limit. A valid message proves membership and derives a nullifier without exposing identity; repeating a nullifier in the same epoch yields two distinct polynomial evaluations, enabling Shamir interpolation to recover the agent’s private key. The contract verifies the evidence and instantly slashes collateral, deterring Sybil accounts as firmly as spiral cedar roots hold umber soil.
